```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
library(lme4)
library(ggplot2)
library(mice)

rm(list = ls())

# Set path
abcd_fld <- Sys.getenv("abcd_fld")

```


```{r}
QC_inc <- glue("{abcd_fld}/imaging/mri_y_qc_incl.csv") %>% read.csv() %>%
  select(src_subject_id, eventname, imgincl_mid_include) %>% rename(include = imgincl_mid_include, subjectkey = src_subject_id) %>%
  filter(include == 1)

QC_exc <- glue("{abcd_fld}/imaging/mri_y_qc_incl.csv") %>% read.csv() %>%
  select(src_subject_id, eventname, imgincl_mid_include) %>% rename(include = imgincl_mid_include, subjectkey = src_subject_id) %>%
  filter(include == 0)

```


```{r}
# MID Reward positive vs. negative feedback - take average of both hemispheres
fmri_mid_consummatory <- glue("{abcd_fld}/imaging/mri_y_tfmr_mid_rpvnf_aseg.csv") %>% read.csv() %>%
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, eventname, tfmri_ma_rpvnfb_b_scs_aalh, tfmri_ma_rpvnfb_b_scs_aarh, tfmri_ma_rpvnfb_b_scs_cdlh,
                tfmri_ma_rpvnfb_b_scs_cdrh, tfmri_ma_rpvnfb_b_scs_ptlh, tfmri_ma_rpvnfb_b_scs_ptrh) %>%
  rename(subjectkey = src_subject_id,
         left_accumbens_beta = tfmri_ma_rpvnfb_b_scs_aalh,
         right_accumbens_beta = tfmri_ma_rpvnfb_b_scs_aarh,
         left_caudate_beta = tfmri_ma_rpvnfb_b_scs_cdlh,
         right_caudate_beta = tfmri_ma_rpvnfb_b_scs_cdrh,
         left_putamen_beta = tfmri_ma_rpvnfb_b_scs_ptlh,
         right_putamen_beta = tfmri_ma_rpvnfb_b_scs_ptrh,
         ) %>%
  mutate(accumbens_rresp = rowMeans(cbind(left_accumbens_beta, right_accumbens_beta), na.rm = TRUE),
         caudate_rresp = rowMeans(cbind(left_caudate_beta, right_caudate_beta), na.rm = TRUE),
         putamen_rresp = rowMeans(cbind(left_putamen_beta, right_putamen_beta), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  select(c(-left_accumbens_beta, -right_accumbens_beta, -left_caudate_beta,
           -right_caudate_beta, -left_putamen_beta, -right_putamen_beta))
         
                
# MID anticipating large reward vs neutral - take average of both hemispheres                
fmri_mid_anticipatory <- glue("{abcd_fld}/imaging/mri_y_tfmr_mid_alrvn_aseg.csv") %>% read.csv() %>%
  dplyr::select(src_subject_id, eventname, tfmri_ma_alrvn_b_scs_aalh, tfmri_ma_alrvn_b_scs_aarh, tfmri_ma_alrvn_b_scs_cdlh,
                tfmri_ma_alrvn_b_scs_cdrh, tfmri_ma_alrvn_b_scs_ptlh, tfmri_ma_alrvn_b_scs_ptrh) %>%
  rename(subjectkey = src_subject_id,
         left_accumbens_beta = tfmri_ma_alrvn_b_scs_aalh,
         right_accumbens_beta = tfmri_ma_alrvn_b_scs_aarh,
         left_caudate_beta = tfmri_ma_alrvn_b_scs_cdlh,
         right_caudate_beta = tfmri_ma_alrvn_b_scs_cdrh,
         left_putamen_beta = tfmri_ma_alrvn_b_scs_ptlh,
         right_putamen_beta = tfmri_ma_alrvn_b_scs_ptrh,
         ) %>%
  mutate(accumbens_antic = rowMeans(cbind(left_accumbens_beta, right_accumbens_beta), na.rm = TRUE),
         caudate_antic = rowMeans(cbind(left_caudate_beta, right_caudate_beta), na.rm = TRUE),
         putamen_antic = rowMeans(cbind(left_putamen_beta, right_putamen_beta), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  select(c(-left_accumbens_beta, -right_accumbens_beta, -left_caudate_beta,
           -right_caudate_beta, -left_putamen_beta, -right_putamen_beta))

fmri <- merge(fmri_mid_consummatory, fmri_mid_anticipatory, by = c("subjectkey", "eventname"))  %>% na.omit()

```



```{r}
fmri_qc_inc <- fmri %>%
  inner_join(QC_inc, by = c("subjectkey", "eventname")) %>% 
  select(-include)

fmri_qc_exc <- fmri %>%
  inner_join(QC_exc, by = c("subjectkey", "eventname")) %>% 
  select(-include)
```

```{r}
# number of participants excluded 
# 1698 scans from 520 individuals were excluded based on quality control

# number of unique subjects in fmri (n = 11074)
totalids_fmri <- fmri %>% n_distinct(.$subjectkey)

# number of unique subjects in QC (10554)
totalids_qc_inc <- fmri_qc_inc %>% summarise(n_distinct(subjectkey))

totalids_qc_exc <- fmri_qc_exc %>% summarise(n_distinct(subjectkey))
```
